data.title: 三国家庭能源消耗对比
data.prompt:
The chart below shows how much energy an average household used for heating, cooking and lighting in three countries in 2025.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

data.title: 远程办公利大于弊吗
data.prompt:
More and more people now work from home for part of the week.

Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
